text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health (TPH) Operating Budget Variance for the twelve months ended on December 31, 2018. As of December 31, 2018, TPH's 2018 Operating Budget was underspent by $51.2 thousand net (0.1 percent).
The Board of Health received the report (May 31, 2019) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
